tenantId.Description: Id of the tenant to deploy to. Can be found in the Azure Active Directory blade.

spoTenantName.Description: Name of the SharePoint tenant to deploy to (excluding .sharepoint.com) e.g. contoso

fullTenantName.Description: Full name of the tenant to deploy to e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com

requestsSiteName.Description: Name of the SharePoint site to store the requests, can include spaces (URL/Alias auomatically generated). If the site exists, it will prompt to overwrite and will apply the provisioning template.

requestsSiteAlias.Description: Alias for the site: decides the URL (/<managedPath>/<alias>) and the Microsoft 365 group mail (<alias>@<maildomain>). KEEP THE DEFAULT: the Teams app has the site URL hardcoded to /<managedPath>/bestillingsportalen, so the site must live there. The alias shares a namespace with every user and group in the tenant, so a service account called bestillingsportalen@... occupies it - deploy.ps1 stops in pre-flight if it does. Then create the site with a free alias (e.g. 'BP'), rename the site URL to /<managedPath>/bestillingsportalen in the SharePoint admin center, and set this parameter to 'bestillingsportalen' for later runs. Leave blank to derive it from requestsSiteName (pre-2.0 behaviour).

requestsSiteDesc.Description: Description for the site that will be created above.

managedPath.Description: Managed path configured in the tenant e.g. 'sites' or 'teams' (no forward slash).

subscriptionId.Description: Azure subscription id to deploy the solution to. All resources in an Azure subscription are billed together.

region.Description: The Azure region to deploy to. The internal name should be used. Not every resource is available in every region.

resourceGroupName.Description: A name for a new resource group to deploy the solution to - if the resource group does not exist it will be created.

uamiName.Description: Name for the user-assigned managed identity that the logic apps use to authenticate against Microsoft Graph, SharePoint and Azure Automation.

pnpAppId.Description: Id of the PnP Entra app registration. (defaults to Prosjektportalen PnP app)

siteLogoPath.Description: Path to a company logo which will be set as the site logo for Communication sites and no Group Team Sites when provisioned. Optional - can be left blank.

guestEntraGroup.Description: Object id (recommended) or display name of an Entra ID group that every guest invited through the InviteGuests web part is added to, in addition to the invited site - e.g. a group granted read access to the hub site and app catalog. Optional - leave blank to disable.

serviceAccountUPN.Description: UPN of Service Account to be used for the solution - used to connect to SharePoint and send Emails in the Logic App.

isEdu.Description: Specifies whether the current tenant is an Education tenant. If set to true, the Education Teams Templates will be deployed. These will be skipped if set to false or left blank.

skipApplySPOTemplate.Description: Skip applying the PnP template to the SharePoint site.
